description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the colorectal cancer detection feature (ScreenCRC) in the image analysis and processing (imageprocess) category
description_zh: 本文介绍图像分析处理（imageprocess）类目下的结直肠癌检测ScreenCRC的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun imageprocess screen-crc --data-format DICOM --org-name '测试组织' --org-id 7ff51bfe-e73d-11ea-827d-506b4b3f3cf6 --data-source-type HTTP_FILES --url-list URL=https://medclients-sh.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/demo/xxx/0001.dcm --region cn-hangzhou
name: ScreenCRC

parameters.help_en: The format of the image. DICOM and NIfTI are supported
parameters.name: data_format

parameters.help_en: The name of the sub-channel (organization, such as a hospital) under the current channel (Alibaba Cloud account)
parameters.help_zh: 当前渠道（即主账号）下的子渠道（即机构，如医院）名称
parameters.name: org_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the sub-channel (organization, such as a hospital) under the current channel (Alibaba Cloud account)
parameters.help_zh: 当前渠道（即主账号）下的子渠道（即机构，如医院）标识
parameters.name: org_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the input data. HTTP_FILES is supported. HTTP_FILES indicates series files
parameters.help_zh: 输入数据的类型，支持HTTP_FILES，HTTP_FILES为序列文件
parameters.name: data_source_type

fields.help_en:
The URL list of DICOM series files or NIfTI files ["url","url",...].

We recommend that you use OSS links in the China (Shanghai) region. If your files are stored locally or in an OSS region other than China (Shanghai), refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
N in URLList.N.URL indicates the sequence number of the image URL in the current list (starting from 1). When you directly use the API, specify URLList parameters in the format of URLList.1.URL=url1, URLList.2.URL=url2, and so on. Separate parameter pairs with ampersands (&). Replace url1, url2, and other values with actual values. When you use an SDK, use the corresponding methods provided by the SDK
fields.help_zh:
DICOM序列文件URL列表或NIFTI文件URL列表["url","url",...]。

推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
URLList.N.URL中的N为该图像URL在当前List中的顺序（从1开始）。当直接使用API请求时，输入URLList的填充会以URLList.1.URL=url1，URLList.2.URL=url2，......的方式指定参数和参数值，参数对以&连接，其中url1、url2、......等具体值请根据实际情况进行替换；当使用SDK填充URLList时，可直接使用SDK提供的相应的方法
fields.name: url

parameters.help_en: The URL list of DICOM series files or NIfTI files ["url","url",...]
parameters.name: url_list

Data.description_en: The data must be obtained after the asynchronous task executes successfully by invoking the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and performing JSON deserialization on the Result field
Data.description_zh: 该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

CRCVolume.description_en: The colorectal cancer lesion volume, in cubic centimeters (cm³)
CRCVolume.description_zh: 结直肠癌病变体积，单位：立方厘米（cm³）

ColorectumVolume.description_en: The colorectal volume, in cubic centimeters (cm³)
ColorectumVolume.description_zh: 结直肠体积，单位：立方厘米（cm³）

Mask.description_en:
The lesion mask, provided as an HTTP URL.

The URL is valid for 30 minutes. After 30 minutes, the URL expires and must be regenerated
Mask.description_zh:
病灶Mask，以HTTP地址给出。

有效时间为30分钟，30分钟后链接失效，需要重新生成

Probabilities.description_en: The probabilities of the two-class classification prediction, corresponding to healthy and colorectal cancer, respectively
Probabilities.description_zh: 两类分类预测的概率，依次对应健康、结直肠癌

Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
